$comment: Known flaky tests that get two retries in CI only (process.env.CI), never locally. Each entry names its file, its full test name (describe blocks and test joined with ' > '), an owner and the evidence. A retried test is listed in its vitest job's summary. Fix the test, then delete its entry. docs/ci.md, 'Flaky tests'.

tests.test: offers the results again when the person stops the return turn before the provider acts on it
tests.reason: Failed 9 runs (6 branches, 4 main runs) since Sep 24, mostly Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: offers a steer written into a resume the provider then rejected on the next turn
tests.reason: Failed 7 runs (6 branches, 2 main runs) since Sep 24, Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: gives a replacement session the full assignment when a result returns after its resume was rejected
tests.reason: Failed 5 runs since Sep 24, mostly Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: gives a replacement session an earlier round's result that its rebuild could not replay, and credits it only with that rebuild
tests.reason: Failed 5 runs since Sep 24, mostly Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: does not send a message again that a recovery replay carried, including one the unseen limit had deferred
tests.reason: Failed 4 runs since Sep 24, mostly Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: replays again when a replacement session fails before the provider acts on it
tests.reason: Timed out at 60 s in 3 Windows runs since Sep 24 (its timeout now doubles on Windows too).

tests.test: waking a sleeping computer > forgets a server error once a later resume is accepted
tests.reason: Failed 7 runs (3 main runs) since Sep 24: Ubuntu 5, Windows 2. #2444 targeted it; delete this entry once no retry is reported for a week.

tests.test: a bot's memory and a lent Mac (server/lending-memory.ts) > fingerprints the instruction files an engine reads in each working folder and the folders above it
tests.reason: Failed 8 runs (7 branches, 2 main runs) since Sep 24, Windows; same commit later green.

tests.test: a phone's v1 live view on real Chrome > sends the events and fields the agent-browser engine sent, step for step
tests.reason: Failed 11 times since Oct 26 in browser driver S4 (ubuntu-latest), on the host and in the container; five of the six logged failures are one stall of about 50 s in which navigate through tab-new get no picture. Not reproduced in 72 runs on ubuntu-latest on Oct 29. Each attempt starts its own Chrome.

tests.test: fails only turns whose own steps end in an upstream error
tests.reason: Timed out at 40s twice in one Windows shard run of 839308c052 (136416ms for 7 tests); passes locally in ~1s across 3 runs and on other OSes in the same commit. Disk/SQLite latency under shard load.

tests.test: does not load a step that is no error, or an error step too large to read quickly
tests.reason: Same Windows shard run as above: timed out at 40s, passes locally and on macOS/Linux in the same commit.

tests.test: stops the coordinator's direct turn without cancelling a routine goal waiting on its worker
tests.reason: Failed identically before and after the rebrand (verified on unmodified HEAD): directReplyStarted poll needs a hostTimeout like its siblings; poll default is tight under shard load.

tests.test: work handed to a bot on Auto runs on that bot's own cloud computer; a consult, and a bot with none, get no computer
tests.reason: Failed identically before and after the rebrand (verified on unmodified HEAD): the handed turn's FAKE_CLAUDE_DUMP never appears within 20s under load.

tests.test: moves a live thread between folders without changing its model or deleting history
tests.reason: Windows shard 7/8 of cbc34a22fe: 'Matcher did not succeed in time' on one poll; 3/3 green locally and green on every other OS shard of the same commit.

tests.test: harness HTTP API > shares one team computer across direct and room turns without overriding explicit destinations
tests.reason: Windows shard 1/8 of 17359038a0: turn.wait_ended event read as undefined once; passes locally on Linux (all 346) and on the ubuntu shards of the same commit.

tests.test: a passkey step in a bot's headless browser on agent-browser > ends the passkey request at once, so Try another way opens the other ways
tests.reason: browser identity (windows-latest) of 17359038a0: agent-browser 0.36.0-omb.1 raced its daemon start once ('started concurrently with different daemon configuration; retry the command'); its own message says retry. Green on ubuntu of the same commit.

tests.test: a move killed twice and another computer's move that fails once stay within the Admin's codes: one session each time the app runs, signed out once done
tests.reason: beforeAll's fixture launch failed once in ubuntu shard 7/8 of 6a6de147fb (My Cloud gave no one-time code: HTTP 401 invalid_signature) and once in 10 local runs; the pairing-code mint races the cloud server's first signed request. Green in the other 9 local runs and on the same commit's other shards.

tests.test: a cloud computer goes to sleep after use and wakes on the next > a teammate's routine keeps the team's shared computer on; one for a teammate whose computer is off does not
tests.reason: Nightly (schedule) run of 9ab2baaf59, shard 3/8: the team computer's row was still 'archived' when the turn had gone idle, once. 9/9 green locally and on the push run of the same commit; the sibling 409 race in the same file is now settled by apiOk itself.

tests.test: routine failure notification wiring > emits one routine-failed notification linking the chat that says the run failed, and no generic done notification
tests.reason: Nightly (schedule) run of 9ab2baaf59, shard 7/8: the notification frame did not arrive inside the 30 s SSE window once under shard load. Green locally and on the push run of the same commit.

tests.test: limits counted per turn on a bearer that outlives the turn > stops a turn at its third room post, and the next turn may post again
tests.reason: Ubuntu shard 2/8 of 1b406d0c9f (docs-only commit): makeBot's PATCH /api/bots came back 409 once while the bot's engine/computer change was still in flight, the API's documented wait state. Green on every other shard and locally.

tests.test: a routine every 5 minutes whose tool server is dead > starts 9 turns in its first day instead of one or two every 5 minutes, stays on, and leaves one row for what it skipped
tests.reason: Windows shard 5/8 of 1b406d0c9f (docs-only commit): timed out at its 40 s once under shard load; the test simulates a day of 5-minute failures. Green locally and on every other shard of the same commit.

tests.test: messages-db check > reports what SQLite's own check finds damaged inside a database it can open
tests.reason: Windows shard 1/8 of a5f6bbed8e: timed out at the default 40 s once on a runner whose whole file ran ~2x slower than its siblings (500 rows and one integrity check are seconds of work); green on every other shard and locally.

tests.test: a cloud computer that says it is ready but does not answer > restarts at most one computer of the installation by itself in ten minutes
tests.reason: Ubuntu shard 4/8 of 450e90eaed: the recovery loop restarted a second computer once before the first verdict landed, under shard load. Green locally and on every other shard of the same commit.

tests.test: incremental shadow index > stops a running collection for a new turn's snapshot, and runs it again behind that turn
tests.reason: Ubuntu shard 7/8 of 450e90eaed: the rerun-behind-the-turn collection was still one when read, once under shard load. Green locally and on every other shard of the same commit.
